recalled_knowledge.item: XENONnT WIMP-search NR ROI: cS1 up to ~100 PE, roughly 3-60 keV
PandaX-4T WIMP-search NR ROI upper edge ~100-120 keV
In-ROI NR acceptance ~0.9 for both experiments; 50% threshold ~5 keV
Anand-Fitzpatrick-Haxton Table 1 entry 10: L10 = chi-bar i sigma^{mu nu} q_nu/m_M chi N-bar i sigma_{mu alpha} q^alpha/m_M N -> 4 (q^2/m_M^2) O4 - 4 (m_N^2/m_M^2) O6
recalled_knowledge.reliability: likely (validated: reproduces LZ Fig. 1 double-peak shape and the isoscalar/isovector degeneracy LZ reports)

recalled_knowledge.item: NREFT nuclear response structure: R_Sigma'' proportional to (c4 + (q^2/m_N^2) c6)^2, R_Sigma' proportional to c4^2 for spin-1/2 DM
Drift fields: XENONnT ~23 V/cm, PandaX-4T ~90 V/cm (LZ 97 V/cm from paper) -> cS1-to-keV mapping of ROI edges differs between experiments
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: XENONnT SR0 and PandaX-4T commissioning papers

recalled_knowledge.item: XENONnT and PandaX-4T adopt the Baxter et al. (2021) SHM conventions
recalled_knowledge.reliability: likely (only affects the statement that dR/dE per t yr is identical; LZ's own halo is used throughout)

failed_or_abandoned: L10 reduction recalled as (q^2/2 m_chi m_M) O1 + 2 (m_N/m_M) O5 - 2 (m_N/m_M)[(q^2/m_N^2) O4 - O6] (DM dipole x nucleon vector current): WimPyDD spectrum is dominated by the coherent O5 term, peaks at 20 keV and has no 200 keV peak, contradicting LZ Fig. 1 and the s/v degeneracy; abandoned in favour of the dipole-dipole entry 10.
First digitisation pass of LZ Fig. 1 included the brown legend line sample (225-250 keV), giving a spurious 227 keV peak and a 9.4 high/low-peak ratio; fixed by masking rows with y > 0.047 /t/yr/keV.
P003 digitised L10 spectrum: not available in output/work/P003/ at time of writing; own colour digitisation used instead.
